extensions.name: Code Editor
extensions.short_description: Monaco-backed code editor as a native Desktop Mode window. Browse and edit files inside wp-content with PHP IntelliSense, capability- and DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT-gated.

extensions.name: Cron Manager
extensions.short_description: Browse, edit, delete, and run WP-Cron events from a native Desktop Mode window.

extensions.name: phpMyAdmin
extensions.short_description: Embeds phpMyAdmin as a native window. Local environments only — phpMyAdmin runs with auth_type=config and gates closed on staging/production.
